# ZoChat
ZoChat is an AI customer service chatbot SaaS for websites, ecommerce stores and service businesses.

## Core capabilities
- Answers from tenant-approved website content and knowledge.
- Uses provider-agnostic server-side tools for live business capabilities.
- Can search products, verify and check orders, create support tickets and access configured business-data resources.
- Supports separate tenant configuration, branding, topics and permissions.
- Embeds on websites using a JavaScript snippet.

## Pricing
- Starter: £29/month ex VAT.
- Growth: £79/month ex VAT.
- Scale: £199/month ex VAT.
Enterprise and custom-volume requirements are quoted separately.
